metadata.description: Plugins for turning source material into reusable knowledge and learning experiences.

plugins.name: create-knowledge-note
plugins.description: Create or revise a concise, self-contained second-brain knowledge note from transcripts, notes, research, or existing thought-leadership material.

plugins.name: create-learning-module
plugins.description: Create a modular self-paced learning experience with complementary participant and coach guides.

plugins.name: create-obsidian-marp
plugins.description: Create a narrative Marp presentation with speaker notes for the Obsidian Marp Slides plugin.
